conventions.binary: values restricted to {0,1}; missing imputed with the rounded training mean; no vocabulary created
conventions.categorical_ids: 0=UNK (unseen), 1=MISSING, 2+=known categories ordered by descending train frequency then ascending value
conventions.leakage: all fitted state originates from training shards only; transform never updates state
conventions.missing_indicators: one 0/1 float column <feature>_missing per feature with training missingness: ['f_30', 'f_31', 'f_43', 'f_51', 'f_58', 'f_59', 'f_64', 'f_65', 'f_66', 'f_67', 'f_68', 'f_69', 'f_70']
conventions.numerical: (x - train_mean) / train_std; missing imputed with train_mean (normalized to 0.0); zero-variance columns map to 0.0
